issue: #390-C — --json/--report emitted error:null for every failed resource, and reprinted stale lock rows

quorum.kill_rule: any un-countered substantive objection kills the claim
refuted_claims: The first version of this test suite verified the fix — REFUTED: only 1 of 3 went red. Two were vacuous (a permissive || disjunction and an assertion hidden inside if let), and both searched a top-level resource_reports that does not exist; the reports live under machines[].resource_reports. Rewritten; all 3 now falsify.

exit_code should be filled in the same change — REFUTED: record_failure receives no exit code and several call sites have none to give. A value parsed out of the error prose would be worse than an absent one. Left None and named as a known limit.
quorum.divergence: the probe lane reported the fix verified; falsification contradicted it and exposed that two of three tests never read the field they claimed to assert on.

systems: Ansible — the JSON callback carries msg, stdout, stderr and rc per task
Terraform — `-json` emits diagnostic records with summary AND detail
Kubernetes — `kubectl get -o json` carries the full status conditions, not a summary
GitHub Actions — the API exposes per-step conclusion and annotations a human never sees on the console
crux.verdict: every surveyed system carries MORE in the machine surface than on the console, on the theory that a human can scroll and a pipeline cannot. forjar carried strictly less — the inversion is the defect.

agy_teamwork.verdict: the 1.24.0 review named this the single biggest thing left on the table for a reporter on a stateless CI runner, and set the precondition that makes it safe
unique_findings: insisted the stale-row half land in the SAME change, because filling the error on a data source that reprints untouched resources turns a contentless row into a convincing wrong one

pmat.quality_gate: new suite absent from the vacuous list; clippy -D warnings 0 errors

falsification.test: reverted both halves (details HashMap::new(), unfiltered lock map) and re-ran the suite
falsification.reverted: resource_ops.rs:141 details -> HashMap::new(); machine_b.rs:100 filter removed
falsification.observed_failure: 3 of 3 went RED: the null error in --json, the missing error key in the lock, and the stale `alpha` row. A FIRST attempt showed only 1 of 3, which exposed two vacuous tests rather than a working fix.
falsification.still_green_when_reverted: none — all three assert behaviour this change introduces
